full_page.content:
1948, January 29th
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
January 29th, 1948 Saint Felix Capuchin Friary, Huntington, Ind.
Bles'd be God in all and each of His designs
Jan. 29th. God bless you Joseph and Winifred
Here are the verses - some of them at least - I referred to Sunday-night. Before further neglect I'll put them in and they'll escape being " snowed under."
God Bless you again and keep well - tempering down on the cig's.
Fr. Solanus.
Praised be Jesus!
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap. C. 1948
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Ind.
Bles'd be God in all and each of His designs.
October 11 new Feast of "Maternity of Mary Bles'd Virgin."
God bless you Joseph O'Donnell - you and yours
May this find you all in the best of outlooks - with lively, firm and ardent faith, hope and charity! - the triune virtue.
I am just enclosing the belated account referred to over long-distance last night. I hope you may find it worth while.
Sincerely Yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Bles'd be God in the Maternity of our Bl. Virgin Mother Mary:
